title: ArcCivs181 navigation territory cleanup and exact-slot control relocation
assumptions: Runtime0.1.180 is the baseline.0.1.181 changes navigation, natural vegetation maintenance and physical control placement; production rates, recipe quantities, reward chances and paid accepted jobs are unchanged.

Participants1/7/16 settlements and maintenance events1/100/10000 per settlement-day are sensitivity inputs, not measured throughput. Every direct currency and player XP amount is zero before and after.

Vegetation writes AIR with physics=false and has no drop, item, XP, Stock or inventory issuance. Productive forester groves and already accepted forestry jobs stay protected; removal consumes finite existing natural world trees without creating saleable items.

Control relocation moves exact existing native slots and NBT from one27-slot barrel to another; no resource reward, item refund or inventory rewrite is allowed. Per-item conservation is checked by native receipt tests, not an invented exchange rate.

Bulk chunk snapshots and faster routing can increase completed legitimate work per hour. The scale is unmeasured before delivery; per-action yields, debits, resident skill and existing supply caps are unchanged. Native comparable route and paid-commit observations are required separately.

Existing-gate maintenance issues no items or resources. Future generated flat-gate material sinks are assessed separately in gate-refit-economy-20261101.json; stepped existing gates retain their exact native floor.

No combined currency unit or item SELL quote is used. Active SELL/AutoSell and planned SELL-to-contract remain separate; no downstream sales, savings or new earning potential are inferred from zero direct money mint.

flows.source: CivsVillageVegetation, CivsControlRelocations, CivsNavigationSnapshots; existing gate assessment is separate
